purpose: Vendor-side sub-steps (kind: vendor-step): where the value lives in the vendor console, which Segmently field receives it, how to verify it landed. Source for the generated article registry — never edit article-registry.json by hand.

subarticles.title: Pixel ID from Meta Events Manager
subarticles.summary: Open Meta Events Manager, choose Data sources, select your pixel and open Settings: the Pixel ID is shown at the top. Paste it into the Facebook Pixel integration. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
subarticles.verifyHint: Events Manager → Test events shows PageView from the published funnel URL.

subarticles.title: Conversions API access token
subarticles.summary: In the same pixel's Settings scroll to Conversions API and click Generate access token; copy it once — Meta does not show it again. Paste it into the Facebook Conversions API integration. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
subarticles.verifyHint: A server event carrying fbc/fbp appears in Events Manager → Test events.

subarticles.title: Pixel code from TikTok Events Manager
subarticles.summary: Open TikTok Events Manager, choose Web events and select your pixel: the pixel code (starts with C) is shown in the header. Paste it into the TikTok Pixel integration; the Events API integration uses the same code. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
subarticles.verifyHint: Events Manager → Test events shows a page view from the published funnel URL.

subarticles.title: Events API access token
subarticles.summary: In the same pixel open Settings and click Generate Access Token; copy it and paste it into the TikTok Events API integration. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
subarticles.verifyHint: A server event carrying ttclid appears in Events Manager → Test events.

subarticles.title: GA4 Measurement ID
subarticles.summary: In Google Analytics open Admin, Data streams, select the web stream: the Measurement ID (starts with G-) is at the top right. Paste it into the GA4 integration. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
subarticles.verifyHint: GA4 Realtime report shows a user from the published funnel URL.

subarticles.title: GA4 Measurement Protocol API secret
subarticles.summary: In the same web stream open Measurement Protocol API secrets and click Create; paste the secret into the GA4 Measurement Protocol (server) integration. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
subarticles.verifyHint: GA4 DebugView shows the server-sent event.

subarticles.title: Mixpanel project token and service account
subarticles.summary: In Mixpanel open Project Settings, Access Keys: copy the Project Token into the Mixpanel integration. For the server integration create a service account under Organization, Service Accounts and paste its username and secret together with the project id. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
subarticles.verifyHint: Mixpanel Events → Live view shows the funnel events.

subarticles.title: Amplitude API key and server zone
subarticles.summary: In Amplitude open Settings, Projects, select the project: copy the API Key into the Amplitude integration and pick the zone from your organisation URL (analytics.eu.amplitude.com means EU). Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
subarticles.verifyHint: Amplitude User Look-Up finds a user from the published funnel URL.

subarticles.title: PostHog project API key and host
subarticles.summary: In PostHog open Project Settings: copy the Project API key (starts with phc_) into the PostHog integration and set the host that matches your region (US or EU cloud, or your self-hosted URL). Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
subarticles.verifyHint: PostHog Live events shows the funnel events.

subarticles.title: Activate the live Stripe account before connecting
subarticles.summary: In the Stripe Dashboard click Activate payments and complete the business details so charges and payouts are enabled; only then run Connect Live Account in Segmently — an unactivated account connects but cannot charge. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
subarticles.verifyHint: The Stripe card in Segmently shows Connected with live charges enabled.

subarticles.title: Add the A and CNAME records at your registrar
subarticles.summary: Open your DNS provider (GoDaddy, Namecheap or Cloudflare) and add the two records Segmently printed: the A record for the domain and the CNAME for certificate validation; on Cloudflare keep the proxy OFF (grey cloud) for the validation CNAME. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
vendorPath: Add record: A + CNAME (Cloudflare proxy off)
subarticles.verifyHint: segmently domains verify-dns reports ready and the domain card shows Active.
